about: Three references that are filled and name no row: an ordinary one (a cast link to character 404), a polymorphic one (a thematic connection to character 404, found through its `entity_type` sibling, §12.1.2), and a uuid stored as text in an integer reference column, which is what a writer that skips the uuid-to-row-id step leaves behind. Each is `reference.dangling` (§9.1): one finding per column. None is `junction.endpoint_absent`, because the column is not empty; every query still answers (§9.2), and the link is not there.

findings.message: motif_appearance.entity_id holds a value naming no row on 1 row(s): the reference is filled and points nowhere, so every query resolves it to nothing (§9.2).
